llmCodeSupport.label: Claude Code (Anthropic's CLI coding assistant)
llmCodeSupport.note: The feature installs the `claude` CLI at build time, independently of the stack; the extension is only the editor integration. Both are needed for full support. The CLI ships unauthenticated — run `claude` to log in or set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (never commit it).

gitConfig.label: Global git config (identity, sane defaults, aliases)
gitConfig.note: A fresh container starts with no git identity. This writes a `.devcontainer/gitconfig` and wires it in via `git config --global include.path` on container create, so it layers on top of any existing ~/.gitconfig without clobbering it. Stack-independent.
